integrity: The all-sample-size proof is an exact Hilbert-space quadratic-form calculation using the uniform empirical bridge. A standalone rational-arithmetic checker independently integrates the classical order-statistic formulas over ordered simplices through sample size eight. The finite replay supplements rather than replaces the proof.
scientific_limitations: The null distribution must be fully specified and continuous; fitted-parameter empirical processes are not covered.
The theorem gives second-order dependence, not the full joint law.
Watson's 1961 full text was inaccessible after bounded open-access and institutional attempts, leaving a small historical comparison risk.
title: Cramér–von Mises and Watson statistics have an exact finite-sample correlation
